description: Look up business partners (customers and/or vendors) from the tenant's partner master. Filters (all optional): search (case-insensitive substring over name, code, email, and phone number); partnerType (customer, supplier, or both [default] — unknown values are rejected). Ordered by name. Paged: returns Total (pre-paging) plus the page; default 100, max 500. Each partner includes any custom field values set on it (see list_custom_fields, entity=businessPartner). The partner master is tenant-shared (no client dimension), so any read principal — operator or client-pinned — sees the same rows, matching the canonical REST endpoint.

partnerType.description: Role filter: customer, supplier, or both (default).

search.description: Case-insensitive substring match over name, code, email, and phone number.

name: lookup_business_partners
title: Look Up Business Partners
